configurePresets.name: msvc-unicode-canary
configurePresets.displayName: MSVC x64, UNICODE explicitly ON (endgame:P4.2 - now the default; kept for a separate build dir)
configurePresets.description: UNICODE/_UNICODE is the DEFAULT build since endgame:P4.2 - this preset now only differs from `msvc` by using its own binaryDir, which keeps a second set of artifacts available for side-by-side comparison. It is no longer expected to fail: the whole solution builds at 0 errors with the define and the private gate is 188/188. There is no narrow configuration to build: UNICODE/_UNICODE are set unconditionally in CMakeLists.txt and no option disables them.
